claim: A message will be sent to your phone claiming to show that the Covid19 curve is flattening in India, But It will contain a malicious file

sub_claims.question: Was the Covid19 curve flattening in India around October 2020?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, by mid-October 2020, India's Covid19 cases were declining after the first peak, indicating that the curve was flattening or had flattened.

evidence.statement: India's daily Covid19 cases peaked at 97,894 on September 17, 2020.
By October 15, 2020, India's daily Covid19 cases had declined to 55,342, showing a reduction from the peak.
